duplicate_rule: deduplicate identical normalized (user, provider, session, round_id) records copied across projects; conflicting normalized duplicates fail closed
admission_rule: reported prefix counts are not token identities and cannot authorize reuse
release_rule: successor = simulated predecessor completion + scenario delay; no original LLM latency replay
tool_policy: all matching tools released together at simulated response completion; wait for maximum matched tool latency
limitations: proprietary-model token lengths are transferred shapes, not open-model tokenization
no prompt/token IDs, first-token endpoint or exact streamed tool dependency graph
human gap uses last assistant event as an uncertain completion proxy
unresolved links remain unresolved; they cannot silently become zero-delay requests
prefix count bounds do not validate prefix cache correctness or cross-session sharing
deterministic session split is not independent hardware validation
